WhatsApp recently allowed iPhone users to add a second account within the same app, and is now preparing to expand support to up to three accounts. Here are the details.

WhatsApp will support up to three accounts

Last June, WhatsApp officially launched multi-account support for iPhone, allowing users to add a second account within the same app.

After several months of Beta testing, the feature was officially launched, eliminating the need for users to rely on WhatsApp Business as an alternative for managing a second account.

According to WABetaInfo, the app appears to be expanding this feature, allowing users to switch between up to three accounts without having to log out.

WABetaInfo reports:

The report adds that each account will retain its own conversation history, notifications, privacy settings, backups, and media files.

WABetaInfo noted that while two accounts may be sufficient for many users, this feature will be very useful for those who have different combinations of work and personal phone numbers.

However, the feature is still in development and has not yet been made available to Beta testers, meaning it may be some time before a wider rollout.
